stemMd: Complete combustion of a hydrocarbon in excess oxygen produces which substances?
explanationMd: Carbon is fully oxidised to carbon dioxide and hydrogen to water. Product identities follow the elements in the hydrocarbon and the specification of complete combustion in excess oxygen.

distractorRationale.a: These are not the complete oxidation products.
distractorRationale.c: A pure hydrocarbon supplies no nitrogen.
distractorRationale.b: Excess oxygen and complete combustion favour carbon dioxide.
distractorRationale.e: There is no sodium or chlorine source.
